findings.element: Schedule card · Every day / Per day toggle
findings.finding: Switching to Every day on a Per day schedule shows an empty 'No events.' list. Switching from Every day to Per day the first time copies the list into every day, so the same toggle carries events one way and drops them the other way.
findings.user_impact: An operator who wants to merge per-day lists into one sees all events disappear. They either retype every event or save a schedule they think is empty.
findings.suggested_fix: When switching Per day → Every day, seed the Every day list from the selected day, or confirm before replacing.

evidence.action: Opened 'Weekend shutdown — Ashkelon' (Per day, Mon · 1, Fri · 1) and clicked Every day.
evidence.observed: The list read 'No events.', the timeline showed 0 off segments and no confirmation appeared. Save then failed with 'Add at least one event'.

findings.finding: The Week timeline has only seven weekday rows and no Holidays row, although Holidays is an editable tab with its own events.
findings.user_impact: Holiday events are the only events the operator cannot check visually before saving.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Holidays row under Sat in the Week timeline.

evidence.action: Opened 'Weekend shutdown — Ashkelon'; switched a new schedule to Per day, which seeded Holidays · 2.
evidence.observed: 'holidays row present=false' and 'rows=7', while the tab strip showed 'Holidays · 2'.

findings.element: Schedule card · Per day tab strip (error on a tab that is not open)
findings.finding: When an invalid event sits on a day tab that is not open, the only cue is red text on that tab's label, and the summary does not name the day.
findings.user_impact: After Save fails, the operator sees a clean event list and a count of errors with nothing to fix.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the affected days in the error summary and make each name switch to that tab.

evidence.action: In Per day mode, left an invalid time ('6') on Mon while viewing Sun, then clicked Save.
evidence.observed: Summary: 'Fix 2 fields before saving'. The Mon tab text turned rgb(211,47,47); Sun tab showed no error text.

findings.finding: The conflict error does not name the station or device that clashes, or which day tab of this schedule causes it.
findings.user_impact: With several stations picked, the operator has to guess which station or event to change.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the shared station (and device) to each conflict line.

evidence.action: Picked Akko and Ashkelon, set Per day events, clicked Save.
evidence.observed: Summary 'Fix 1 field before saving'; alert 'Conflicts with South line evening at Sun 23:00 on 1 device'; cleared only after deleting the Ashkelon chip.
